resources.string: Wait for the camera Bluetooth handshake to finish.
The remote command or key release failed. The camera may not have acted; check the body settings and do not retry an uncertain exposure blindly.
Key release could not be confirmed. Check the camera before starting another operation.
BULB start or end is uncertain. Releasing keys alone does not end Bluetooth BULB. Check the camera and end exposure on the body if needed; do not blindly send another start/stop press.
Check the duration, interval and trigger-count limits.
Stop the current remote operation first. If release or BULB is uncertain, check the camera and acknowledge the warning before leaving.
